text:
Maya Singh: tiny design review for the roll history compact mode. main asks: make rollforward explicit, clarify variant labels for non-technical users, and ensure timeline scrubber announces status. sharing figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/roll-history
Owen Park: thumbs up on the compact layout. one readability issue: variant pills show full model slugs and wrap on narrow widths. proposal: show short label + optional pill with expanded id.
Tara Gomez: agree. Copy suggestion for short labels: use human prefix + letter, e.g., "Canary A", "Control B". keep full slug in tooltip and flyout.
Maya Singh: good. UX question: when we offer both Roll back and Roll forward in the context menu, should we list them in chronological order or group by safety (safer action first)?
Owen Park: prefer chronological: "Roll back to this" then "Roll forward from this" so it's spatially consistent with timeline direction. disable rollforward when there's no later checkpoint.
Accessibility Bot: ARIA guidance: for scrubber updates use aria-live="polite" and emit concise phrases like: "History: Mar 21, 2026 1 staged 10% to Canary A (canary)" and "History: Mar 20, 2026 1 rolled back to v2.0 (reverted)". also include a visually-hidden status label per checkpoint.
Tara Gomez: modal copy debate: action menu uses short verb "Rollback" / "Roll forward". confirmation modal should be explicit: title "Confirm roll forward"; body "Make v3.0 live for all traffic? Audit note (optional):" primary button "Roll forward" secondary "Cancel". legal prefers explicit language in the modal.
Maya Singh: we'll mirror that. Also adding an optional reason field that becomes part of the timeline metadata. UI will show truncated note with full on click.
Owen Park: micro-interaction: after rollforward show a transient banner "Rolled forward to v3.0 — Undo" with 20s timeout. Undo must be reachable by keyboard and announced via aria-live.
Accessibility Bot: ensure the banner uses role="status" and the Undo button receives initial focus only if triggered by keyboard shortcut; otherwise trap focus in the modal during confirmation.
PreviewBot: preview deployed for branch `compact-roll-history` at sha 789abc 1 preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/compact-roll-history
Tara Gomez: leaving a couple inline comments on the Figma frames about touch targets and badge contrast. will re-review once updated. :+1:
